name: 5-MeO-NIPT
summary: The drug has limited information on it. It is a psychedelic tryptamine and analogue of NiPT. The drug is structurally related to DiPT and DET.

pharmacology.text: 5-MeO-NiPT is a full agonist or near-full agonist of the serotonin 5-HT1A, 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2C receptors. It is inactive as a serotonin releasing agent and is very weak as a serotonin reuptake inhibitor. Unlike most other N-monoalkylated tryptamines, 5-MeO-NiPT produces the head-twitch response (HTR), a behavioral proxy of psychedelic effects, in rodents, albeit relatively weakly. It also produces hypolocomotion and hypothermia in rodents.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: 5-MeO-NiPT was not included nor mentioned in Alexander Shulgin's book TiHKAL (Tryptamines I Have Known and Loved).

summaryZh: 5-MeO-NiPT，化學名5-甲氧基-N-異丙基色胺是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C14H20N2O，屬於色胺衍生物，是5-MeO-MiPT（5-甲氧基-N-甲基-N-異丙基色胺）、5-MeO-DiPT（5-甲氧基-N,N-二異丙基色胺）在體內的活性代謝產物。
summaryZhHans: 5-MeO-NiPT，化学名5-甲氧基-N-异丙基色胺是一种含氮有机化合物，化学式C14H20N2O，属于色胺衍生物，是5-MeO-MiPT（5-甲氧基-N-甲基-N-异丙基色胺）、5-MeO-DiPT（5-甲氧基-N,N-二异丙基色胺）在体内的活性代谢产物。

fact.en: Unlike most psychedelic tryptamines, it does not produce the head-twitch response in rodents, the usual animal sign of psychedelic activity, even though it switches on the 5-HT2A receptor.
fact.zh: 與多數迷幻色胺不同，它不會在鼠類身上引起甩頭反應，而這是動物出現迷幻活性的常見指標，儘管它確實會活化5-HT2A受體。
fact.zhHans: 与多数迷幻色胺不同，它不会在鼠类身上引起甩头反应，而这是动物出现迷幻活性的常见指针，尽管它确实会活化5-HT2A受体。
